hypothesis: A Phase-4 CP-3 process gate can record that the Track-E Sedan/TMeasy evidence package is complete while Track F remains blocked on PI target and GPU-days budget confirmation before validation ranking promotion driver-performance current-sim high-fidelity full-driver repair-success robustness-result feasibility-proof paper or self-ID claim.

parent_objective: Phase-4 Track E has completed E1/E2/E3 on the default Chrono Sedan/TMeasy fixture
Track F may not start before PI CP-3 confirms targets and budget
derived_from: M3252 completed the full E2 clean Chrono belief-value verdict
M3255 completed the full E3 detector-latency and recovery-budget verdict with CP-3 evidence ready
blocked_by: Track F targets and GPU-days budget are not approved
Codex sessions may not self-approve Track F
supersedes: treating next_task=null as an implicit Track-F approval
starting F1 from completed Track E without an explicit CP-3 disposition
invalidates: using M3255 CP-3 evidence readiness as CP-3 approval
creating completed bookkeeping milestones while waiting for PI

public_gates: The CP-3 gate must cite completed E1, E2, and E3 artifacts
The CP-3 gate must record that Track F remains blocked until PI confirms targets and budget
The CP-3 gate must not run training, mutate the incumbent, or admit Track F
The CP-3 gate must be represented as a blocked queue row, not a completed bookkeeping milestone
forbidden_shortcuts: do not start F1/F2/F3 before the PI disposition
do not launch PPO, supervised training, guarded RL, or policy checkpoints from this gate
do not claim driver performance, full high-fidelity sufficiency, paper readiness, repair success, feasibility proof, Track F admission, or self-ID from this process gate

workflow_synthesis.evidence_increment: records that Track E is complete and Track F is blocked on PI CP-3 rather than on missing E evidence
workflow_synthesis.claim_scope: Process blocker only; incumbent unchanged; no validation ranking, promotion, driver-performance, current-sim sufficiency, full high-fidelity sufficiency, paper, repair-success, robustness-result, feasibility-proof, Track F admission, or self-ID claim
stop_condition: stop while CP-3 has no PI disposition
resume only after PI records approval, rejection, or a concrete additional preregistered unit
do not convert this blocked gate into a completed bookkeeping milestone
fallback_plan: if PI approves Track F, register the first F1 infrastructure unit with preregistered scope and managed-run discipline
if PI rejects Track F, record the rejection and close Phase-4 Track F
if PI requests more evidence, register that exact preregistered pricing or measurement unit
workflow_synthesis.synthesis_trigger: M3255 completed full E3 and roadmap marks F1-F3 blocked on CP-3

training_stage.stage_objective: Record the CP-3 blocker after Track E completion; no model update.
admission_evidence: M3255 E3 full safety measurement completed
docs/roadmap-phase3-codex-execution.md marks F1-F3 blocked on CP-3
next_stage_criteria: PI CP-3 approval, rejection, or explicit request for an additional preregistered unit
After approval, the next executable unit must be F1 infrastructure and not F2/F3 training

self_id_evidence_discipline.current_frame_substitution_risk: This process gate makes no history or self-ID claim.
history_necessity_tests: none in the CP-3 process gate
self_id_evidence_discipline.temporal_evidence_window: not applicable; no learned policy is evaluated
self_id_evidence_discipline.negative_result_policy: If CP-3 is not approved, report that decision directly rather than converting it into training admission.
allowed_claims: Track E evidence is complete for the Sedan/TMeasy fixture
Track F is blocked on PI CP-3
No Track F admission exists before PI disposition

local_search_guard.evidence_expansion: records the external CP-3 decision dependency after completed Track-E evidence
local_search_guard.paper_verdict_delta: No paper verdict; this preserves the boundary that Track F cannot start without PI.
must_synthesize_if: another CP-3 waiting row is proposed without PI disposition
Track F work is proposed before CP-3
M3255 evidence readiness is treated as approval

success_criteria: docs/escalations/2026-06-13-phase4-cp3-track-f-pi-checkpoint.md records the blocker and resume condition
make research-plan reports no pending task before PI CP-3
failure_criteria: m3256 is marked completed without PI CP-3 disposition

decision_rule: Keep M3256 blocked until PI records a CP-3 disposition. This gate passes only as a blocked-state consistency record; it is not executable research.
